## This week

The division of labor that gives a text-only model hands: judgment to the model as text, execution to code, under the convention that output is read as an execution request. Function calling as the standardized round trip; the tool schema as the entire interface; failures reinjected as readable results; the tool list as the capability boundary — and the honest closing observation that a loop has been running all along, inside the client.
